housing-numbers.notes: London Plan (2016) minimum target of 1,031 additional dwellings per year up to 2025, continuing to 2035. However, this target has since been superseded in the 2021 Lodon Plan, where the 10 year target for Hammersmith and Fulham is 16,090 homes (average 1,609 per annum). Total 22,000 homes distributed across regeneration areas: White City 6,000, Hammersmith Town Centre 2,800, Fulham Regeneration Area 7,000, South Fulham Riverside 4,000, Rest of borough 2,200
